sloka: ये च तत्र महात्मानो मुनयश्चिरजीविनः ।नास्मरंस्तादृशं यज्ञं नाप्यासीत् स कदाचन ।। ७.९२.१४ ॥
transliteration: ye ca tatra mahātmāno munayaścirajīvinaḥ ।nāsmaraṁstādṛśaṁ yajñaṁ nāpyāsīt sa kadācana ।। 7.92.14 ॥

translations.english: Even the great-souled, long-lived sages present there had never remembered or witnessed such a sacrifice before.
